browser.name: Google Chrome retail
browser.profileLifecycle: unique temporary user-data directory per trial; same directory reused across the deliberate full process restart

backendConfiguration.sqlite3MultipleCiphers: published vendor assets; exact lock recorded with package hashes

no_handoff_before_confirmed_save_and_act.detail: flow reads commit previews only after awaiting the encrypted adapter commit/activation promise

wrong_credentials_rejected.detail: wrong synthetic password rejected before any Workspace was opened

conflicting_save_rejected_without_overwr.detail: not exercised per trial; pinned adapters have separate conflict conformance suites

lost_save_reply_recovers_without_duplica.detail: not exercised per trial; pinned adapters have separate lost-reply conformance suites

lock_during_save_prevents_handoff.detail: not exercised per trial; pinned adapters have separate lock/fault conformance suites

stale_review_rejected.detail: Core rejected the stale prepared review (inactive_plan) without changing the current head

conversation_scope_enforced.detail: scoped restore succeeds only after a separately saved observed-send record

recovery_preserves_mappings_and_authorit.detail: fresh SQLite vault restored all trial mappings and observed-send scope using adapter encrypted backup archive

workspaceCreate.endEvent: empty complete bundle confirmed saved and activated

initialVaultPasswordUnlock.startEvent: SQLiteVault.open called with the correct synthetic password

initialWorkspaceOpen.startEvent: SQLiteWorkspace.open called for empty existing workspace
initialWorkspaceOpen.endEvent: empty encrypted bundle decrypted and Core Workspace reconstructed

historyPopulation.endEvent: all history events durably saved and activated

vaultPasswordUnlock.startEvent: SQLiteVault.open called with correct password for populated workspace

existingWorkspaceReopen.startEvent: SQLiteWorkspace.open called for populated existing workspace
existingWorkspaceReopen.endEvent: complete encrypted bundle decrypted and Core Workspace reconstructed

adapterOpenAndUnlock.startEvent: SQLiteVault.open with password called after populated workspace history
adapterOpenAndUnlock.endEvent: adapter workspace opened with authenticated password and Core Workspace reconstructed

approvalToSavedActivation.endEvent: encrypted save confirmed, Core activated, and handoff preview returned

conversationIntentPersistence.endEvent: initial message and pending send intent encrypted-save confirmed

observedSendPersistence.endEvent: observed-send plan save and Core activation confirmed

warmScopedRestore.startEvent: restoreInConversation called with saved observed-send marker

backupRecovery.startEvent: approved encrypted backup import called into a fresh empty vault
backupRecovery.endEvent: Core recovery activated and mappings/authority verified

postRestartSdkInitialization.startEvent: WASM init() called after new Chrome process start

postRestartOpenAndUnlock.startEvent: SQLiteVault.open called after Chrome process restart

postRestartReopen.startEvent: adapter workspace open called after restart
postRestartReopen.endEvent: encrypted bundle decrypted and Core Workspace reconstructed

postRestartScopedRestore.startEvent: restoreInConversation called after full Chrome process restart and explicit credential unlock

processMemory.method: ps -o rss= for Chrome main process

mainThread.source: PerformanceObserver longtask entries in extension page

workerMemory.reason: Chrome does not expose isolated worker heap attribution to this harness

wasmMemory.reason: WASM heap cannot be separated from extension page JavaScript heap

storageBytesWritten.reason: browser APIs do not expose reliable per-operation disk write bytes

measurements.serializedWorkspaceBundleStatus: measured by observing exact Core candidate bundle bytes passed to adapter

encryptedArtifactBytes.reason: published adapter APIs return decrypted records; they do not expose sealed on-disk payload size

instrumentationOverhead.note: named intervals use performance.now; size and long-task observers add bounded work outside most intervals

postRestartSdkInitialization.startEvent: WASM init() called after new Chrome process start

postRestartOpenAndUnlock.startEvent: SQLiteVault.open called after Chrome process restart

postRestartReopen.startEvent: adapter workspace open called after restart
postRestartReopen.endEvent: encrypted bundle decrypted and Core Workspace reconstructed

postRestartScopedRestore.startEvent: restoreInConversation called after full Chrome process restart and explicit credential unlock

browserProcessSampling.method: ps RSS at one second intervals; includes browser process, not child renderer/utility processes

instrumentation.observerOverhead: process sampling runs on host at one-second intervals; page timing excludes host-side process sampling

pilotClassification: diagnostic pilot: harness repository was dirty and source commit predates the integrated harness fixes; not final or frozen-source evidence
